obligations.text: Every command, option value, environment variable, exit code, schema identifier and output path the README names exists in the source, and a surface the live runtime does not implement is stated as not implemented.
Example output in the README is taken from a real run of the documented command, abridged but not invented.
The README names every option and value the built executable prints in its usage text, carries no engine pin chronology, and the gate passes.
